title: Road Hazard Protection Credit on Readjustment Parts — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Road hazard readjustment credit.** A credit is taken off the parts charge of an Alignment Services & Plans readjustment according to the Road Hazard Protection certificate the vehicle's tires carry:

| Certificate on the vehicle's tires | Credit |
|---|---|
| an active Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection or Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate | 4.00 |
| another active road hazard certificate | 2.00 |
| none | 0.00 |

The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

*Hypothetical:* parts amount 3.00 on a vehicle with an active Plus 36-Month certificate: 3.00 less 4.00 would fall below zero, so the parts charge is 0.00.
